process.objective: Build a more owner-friendly review mechanism that decomposes long probes into micro-units and compares observable craft behavior against function-matched FoC target behavior without weakening the blind benchmark boundary.

decisions.change: Added a separate GUIDED_TARGET_DIAGNOSTIC mode rather than replacing blind owner preference.
decisions.declared_reason: The owner reported that reviewing full long passages only yields BOTH_FAIL and does not efficiently expose why the outputs miss the product target.
decisions.expected_effect: Collect higher-resolution owner preference evidence while preserving blind benchmark validity as a separate construct.

decisions.change: Defined rhetorical/functional micro-units, usually 1-3 sentences, rather than arbitrary word-count chunks.
decisions.declared_reason: Owner review should focus on one change in listener state or editorial function at a time.
decisions.expected_effect: Reduce cognitive load and allow precise span-level feedback.

decisions.change: Introduced seven behavior-level review features: INFORMATION_RELEASE, LISTENER_ORIENTATION, FORWARD_PRESSURE, CONCRETENESS_FUNCTION, NARRATOR_STANCE, LOCAL_TRANSFORMATION, SPOKEN_LOAD.
decisions.declared_reason: These features describe observable craft behavior that an owner can compare directly without turning them into a scalar rubric.
decisions.expected_effect: Turn vague feedback such as 'both feel like essays' into repeatable, inspectable product-language signals.

decisions.change: Created a function-matched FoC behavioral target profile that describes transferable craft behavior, not wording/style imitation.
decisions.declared_reason: The owner asked to see similarities and differences against the target directly, but benchmark architecture must avoid pre-vote reference anchoring and style copying.
decisions.expected_effect: Make target gaps legible while keeping FoC CRAFT_ONLY_NOT_TRUTH and non-scalar.

decisions.change: Added MATCHES_TARGET, PARTIAL, MISSES_TARGET, WRONG_TARGET, UNCERTAIN plus optional notes/preferred behavior and boundary correction.
decisions.declared_reason: The owner must be able to reject not only candidate behavior but also an incorrect extracted target itself.
decisions.expected_effect: Prevent FoC-derived target abstractions from silently becoming unquestionable product truth.

decisions.change: Guided session stores source locator and a short candidate excerpt instead of duplicating entire probe text.
decisions.declared_reason: A first attempt to materialize large prose copies was blocked; shorter locator-based cards are also a better fit for the intended review experience.
decisions.expected_effect: Keep diagnostic artifacts small and make review genuinely micro-unit oriented.

implementation_steps.action: Opened Iteration 05 work order preserving blind benchmark boundaries.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Guided review scoped as diagnostic UX, not calibration-valid blind evidence.

implementation_steps.action: Documented guided review protocol and behavior-level feature model.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Review has a micro-unit flow and explicit no-scalar/no-style-copy rules.
Owner labels, source locators, WRONG_TARGET and scalar_score=null are represented.

implementation_steps.action: Added FoC functional target profile and guided Sample A pilot.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Five micro-units can be reviewed independently with candidate-vs-target behavior comparisons.

implementation_steps.action: Routed the active Phase 1 entrypoint through both blind and guided owner-review modes and added a dedicated structural verifier.
implementation_steps.observed_result: The two review modes are explicitly separated and mechanically checkable.

validations.command: Static inspection against Iteration 05 work order
validations.observed_result: Confirmed separate diagnostic mode, micro-unit locators, non-scalar feature comparisons, WRONG_TARGET owner control, and FoC craft-only targets.
Verifier implemented but not executed because no local repository runtime was available in this connector-only turn.

deviations: The first guided pilot covers only five micro-units of Sample A so review ergonomics can be validated before expansion.
A first attempt to embed much larger candidate passages was replaced by source locators plus short excerpts.
unresolved: Collect owner UX feedback on micro-unit size and feature-card usefulness.
Honor WRONG_TARGET whenever a FoC-derived behavior abstraction does not reflect the desired product.
After UX acceptance, add a reusable agent workflow for arbitrary samples and extend to full Section/Episode sentinels.
Run the guided-review verifier in CI or a real checkout.

deliverables.role: five-card guided pilot for Sample A

measurement_design.primary_evaluation: Unchanged: blind holistic owner preference remains the benchmark-valid primary construct.
measurement_design.diagnostic_method: Guided UX decomposes one sample into rhetorical micro-units and compares 3-5 relevant behavior features against function-matched FoC target behaviors.
measurement_design.truth_method: Unchanged and independent; FoC remains CRAFT_ONLY_NOT_TRUTH.
measurement_design.spoken_method: SPOKEN_LOAD remains TEXT_PREDICTION unless audio/listener evidence exists.
measurement_design.target_gap_method: Guided mode may expose FoC-derived behavior targets because benchmark_evidence_eligible=false.
measurement_design.judge_policy: No change; LLM benchmark judge remains SHADOW_ONLY.

dataset_partitions.pilot: Guided Sample A session is PILOT UX evidence only.

output.craft_corpus_coverage: Uses the existing frozen FoC craft corpus through a behavior-level target profile; no truth authority or scalar similarity is assigned.

verifier_result.observed_result: Verifier exists but has not been executed in a local checkout.

known_limitations: Current guided session covers five micro-units of Sample A.
Feature extraction is diagnostic until owner labels it; WRONG_TARGET must be honored.
FoC targets are behavior abstractions, not universal narrative-quality claims.
Guided labels are not blind benchmark-valid preference evidence.
output.summary: Added an owner-friendly guided review mechanism so long probes can be inspected as small functional cards with direct candidate-vs-target behavior gaps while preserving blind benchmark validity as a separate lane.
